title: Skill management
subtitle: List and delist store entries, review submissions, and see who installed what.

list.error: This list could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

store.search: Search by title, author, or catalog_id
store.empty: The store has no entries yet.

dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Be specific — the author sees this in their notification
dialog.reasonRequired: Delisting and rejecting both need a reason.
dialog.failed: That did not go through. Try again shortly.

list.title: List {{title}}
list.body: Once listed, every user can find and install this entry from the store.

delist.title: Delist {{title}}
delist.body: The store stops showing it and no one can install it again; copies already in a sandbox keep working. The author is told why.

approve.title: Approve {{title}}
approve.body: Approving moves this submission into the store's community section, visible to everyone.

reject.title: Reject {{title}}
reject.body: The reason reaches the author along with the skill name and version, and they can resubmit after fixing it.

review.pick: Pick a submission on the left to read it.
review.skillMdNotice: Shown as plain text — no Markdown rendering, nothing executed.
review.archiveRefused: The server did not open this archive (too large, absurdly many members, or not a readable ZIP). No manifest and no file list below does not mean the package is empty — nobody read these bytes.
review.truncated: Too long to show in full; the rest is cut off.
review.filesTruncated: Too many entries to list; only the first ones are shown.
review.downloadFailed: The download failed. Try again shortly.
review.loadFailed: This submission could not be loaded.

installs.search: Search by username, email, or skill name
installs.footnote: Based on install records; a skill someone deleted by hand inside their sandbox is not reflected here.
